# 1 Enoch Chapter 104 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** I swear: in heaven, the angels are speaking well of you before the glory of the Great One. Your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

**2** Hold onto hope. You have been put through shame, evil, and affliction. But that is coming to an end. You will shine like stars in the sky — you will shine and be seen, and the gates of heaven will open for you.

**3** Keep crying out for justice — and justice will come to you. Every bit of suffering you experienced will be charged against the rulers who oversaw it and against everyone who helped those who plundered you.

**4** Hold onto hope. Don't throw it away. You will have the same joy as the angels of heaven.

**5** What are you going to have to do? Nothing. On the day of the great judgment, you won't need to hide. You won't be found guilty. The eternal judgment will have nothing to do with you — forever.

**6** And right now — don't be afraid when you watch sinners grow powerful and successful. Don't join them. Stay away from their violence. Because your future companions will be the armies of heaven.

**7** As for you sinners who say, "No one will ever track down our sins, no one will record them" — every single sin is being written down, every day.

**8** Hear this: light and darkness, day and night — they see everything you do. Everything.

**9** Don't let godlessness take root in your hearts. Don't lie. Don't distort the truth. Don't call the Holy and Great One a liar. Don't keep serving your idols. All your lying, all your godlessness — none of it produces righteousness. It all produces greater and greater sin.

**10** I know this mystery: sinners will work to corrupt and twist the words of righteousness in every way they can. They will speak evil. They will lie. They will practice massive deceptions. They will write books supporting their version.

**11** But here is the other thing I know: when people faithfully write down all my words in their own languages, and they do not change them or leave anything out but record every word exactly as I first testified it —

**12** then another mystery is fulfilled: those books will be given to the righteous and the wise, and they will become a source of joy and integrity and wisdom beyond measure.

**13** The books will be theirs. They will trust them and celebrate them. And every righteous person who has learned from them — every path of integrity they have walked — they will be recompensed for all of it.

---

*PNEUMA notes: V. 2 is the most beautiful verse in the Epistle: "you will shine like the lights of heaven." This is the proto-resurrection promise — the persecuted will become what the stars already are. Vv. 10–13 are an extraordinary meta-passage: the text is worried about its own corruption and transmission. The author knows that lying scribes will produce competing versions. The promise is that faithful transmission will result in books of joy. The Epistle cares about its own survival.*
